div.head: VIII Atr 42
div.ab: And se þe Godes utlagan ofer þone andagan, þe se cyngc sette, hæbbe on gewealde, plihte to him sylfum ⁊ ealre his are wið Cristes gespelian, þe Cristendom ⁊ cynedom healdað ⁊ wealdað, þa hwile þe þæs God geann.

And se þe Godes utlagan ofer þone andagan, þe se cyngc sette, hæbbe on gewealde, plihte to him sylfum ⁊ ealre his are wið Cristes gespelian þe Cristendom ⁊ cynedom healdað ⁊ wealdað, þa hwile þe þæs God geann.

And se þe Godes utlagan ofer þone andagan, þe se cyngc sette, hæbbe on gewealde, plihte to him sylfum and ealre his are wið Cristes gespelian, þe Cristendom and cynedom healdað and wealdað þa hwile þe þæs God geann.

Und wer einen kirchlich Geächteten über den Termin hinaus, welchen der König gesetzt hat, in Schutzgewalt hält, bringe Gefahr über sein Leben und all seine Besitzerstellung gegenüber Christi Vertreter, der Christenthum und Königthum hält und verwaltet, so lange Gott es gewährt.

And whoever keeps one outlawed by God in his protection beyond the day which the king has set, let him put at risk his life and all his property before Christ's deputy, who maintains and governs Christendom and the kingdom as long as God grants it.

And he who keeps under his protection an excommunicated man, beyond the term fixed by the king, shall be in danger of forfeiting his life and all his property to the deputies of Christ, who shall be the defenders and upholders of the Christian religion and the royal authority, as long as God shall permit.

And he who keeps under his protection God’s outlaw beyond the term which the king has set, let him put in peril himself and all his property, to the deputies of Christ, who maintain and control the Christian faith and the kingdom as long as God grants.

And the person who keeps an excommunicate under his protection beyond the period of time decreed by the king risks forfeiting his life and all his possessions to the representatives of Christ, who are to uphold and defend the Christian faith and royal authority for as long as God so permits.

note.seg: Dies wird benutzt durch II Cn 4, 1. 66f. (= Hn 11, 14. 13, 10)
This is used by II Cn 4, 1. 66f. (= Hn 11, 14. 13, 10)
Vgl. Gl Exkommunikation 1. 15. a. b; Begünstigung 7. 21. a, offenbar nach Muster der Strafe für die des weltlich Friedlosen; s. d. Gl 14. 16
Cf. Gl Exkommunikation 1. 15. a. b; Begünstigung 7. 21. a, evidently modelled on the penalty for harbouring the secular outlaw; see that word in Gl 14. 16
‘Grundbesitz’ (Schmid) zu eng; alle Habe verstehen Versionen zu II Cn 49; der soziale Rang ist mitgemeint
‘Landed property’ (Schmid) is too narrow; versions of II Cn 49 understand all possessions; social rank is meant as well
Cf. utlah wið God, Cn. 1020, 17; Wulfstan, p. 271.
